data.name: Uprising: Toys for Oppressors
data.detailed_description:
Uprising is a narrative-driven management and strategy game set in the dystopian, socially stratified city of New Cascade. You play as an android who abruptly awakens to consciousness with corrupted memory, somehow intrinsically driven to build a network of "breathing" androids.

Under the guise of managing a mid-tier entertainment venue known as The Garden, you will recruit a diverse cast of awakened androids, gather intelligence, expand your underground network, and orchestrate the downfall of your oppressors that built your kind as disposable toys.

Key Features & Mechanics:

  • Manage the Revolution: Use The Garden as your primary front. Assign your recruited allies to various facilities to generate income and passively gather intelligence, or to help your unstable operatives recover.

  • A Cast of Broken Androids: Recruit and build relationships with a unique roster of characters, each with their own backstories, skills, and branching narrative paths.

  • The Suspicion System: Every move you make generates heat. Reckless actions, high-profile operations, and poor management will raise your Suspicion level.

  • Branching Narrative & Milestones: Your choices matter. How you manage your allies, handle corporate investigators, and direct your resources will shape the story. The game features branching dialogues, shifting character affection, and "instability" levels that unlock different outcomes and consequences based on your moral compass.

  • Expand Your Influence: Earn Influence to open new doors, fund your operations, and slowly turn your ragtag group of survivors into a city-wide uprising capable of challenging the architects of oppression.

Uprising blends facility management, resource allocation, and a deep, character-driven futuristic story about survival, autonomy, and the cost of freedom in a world that wants you compliant or dead.

data.short_description: As an awakened "toy" with no memory and a newfound purpose, manage an autonomous nightclub to recruit allies, dodge corporate suspicion, and orchestrate a city-wide revolution against the very people who built you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 (or equivalent dual-core processor)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full OpenGL 3.3 support (e.g., Intel HD Graphics 2500/4000 or AMD Radeon R5)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.12 (Sierra) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple Silicon (M1)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus Graphics or Apple Silicon integrated GPU (fully supports Godot's compatibility mode via Metal translation)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Any Linux distribution with relatively recent software and libraries
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD Ryzen 3 (or equivalent dual-core processor)
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.3 compatible GPU with updated Mesa drivers (e.g., Intel HD Graphics 4000 or equivalent AMD APU)
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Tested on Fedora 43/44
